**Chinese name:** 龙芯中科技术股份有限公司 (Lóngxīn Zhōngkē Jìshù Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Formally established in Beijing's Zhongguancun district in April 2010 with funding traced to China's 10th and 11th Five-Year Plans — the clearest case in this tracker of a design house built explicitly for indigenous instruction-set independence, developing its own LoongArch ISA rather than licensing ARM or x86.
:::

## What does this firm design?

General-purpose CPUs (the Loongson 3-series and successors) built on the self-developed LoongArch architecture, used primarily in government, state-owned enterprise, and industrial systems, with growing consumer availability.
